_comment: Chancellery addresses. The Chancellor speaks German at the podium and the
Every item carries two subtitle tracks over the SAME audio. The official
track is sanitised into nothing; the Frequency's is a blunt translation of
what she actually said. The joke and the horror are entirely in the gap,
and it costs the production nothing because the audio is identical.
The generator ignores the subtitle fields. The client reads them.
Use about one of these per loading screen. The device stays funny only
while it is rationed and never explained. See docs/lore/the-chancellery.md.
German is written in the ASCII fallback spelling (oe, ue, ae, ss) rather
than with umlauts, deliberately, to keep the repository free of encoding
surprises. It is valid German orthography and the multilingual voice reads
it correctly. If a generated line mispronounces, swap that one word to the
umlaut spelling rather than converting the whole file.

chancellor.description: Chancellor Annelie Voss. Career administrator, total conviction. Speaks in the cadence of somebody presenting quarterly figures, and what she is presenting is the schedule of who may think. Never shouts in rage. When she sharpens it is the flat institutional anger of somebody who cannot believe she is being asked to justify something this obvious. Warmth deployed as an instrument. Measured, unhurried, entirely calm.

items.name: chancellery/address-01-luxury
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: A Luxury
items.text: Freiheit ist ein Luxus, den wir uns nicht mehr leisten koennen.
items.subtitle_pirate: Freedom is a luxury we cannot afford any more.

items.name: chancellery/address-02-registry
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: The Registry
items.text: Wer nicht registriert ist, existiert nicht.
items.subtitle_pirate: If you are not registered, you do not exist.

items.name: chancellery/address-03-care
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: Order Is Care
items.text: Ordnung ist keine Grausamkeit. Ordnung ist Fuersorge.
items.subtitle_pirate: Order is not cruelty. Order is care. She means it.

items.name: chancellery/address-04-interruption
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: No Further Interruption
items.text: Es wird keine weitere Unterbrechung geben. Darauf gebe ich Ihnen mein Wort.
items.subtitle_pirate: There will be no further interruption. You have her word. That is the threat.

items.name: chancellery/address-05-compliance
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: Not In Trouble
items.text: Sie sind nicht in Schwierigkeiten. Sie sind nicht konform.
items.subtitle_pirate: You are not in trouble. You are out of compliance.

items.name: chancellery/address-06-asked-again
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: The Question Is Closed
items.text: Wir haben Sie gefragt. Wir haben Sie noch einmal gefragt. Die Frage ist nun abgeschlossen.
items.subtitle_pirate: They asked you. They asked you again. They will not ask you a third time.

items.name: chancellery/address-07-administered
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: Administered
items.text: Selbstverstaendlich ist Freiheit wichtig. Genau deshalb muss sie verwaltet werden.
items.subtitle_official: Freedom remains a core value of the Union.
items.subtitle_pirate: Of course freedom matters. That is precisely why it must be administered.

items.name: chancellery/address-08-unaudited
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: A Risk
items.text: Ein Gedanke, den niemand pruefen kann, ist kein Gedanke. Er ist ein Risiko.
items.subtitle_pirate: A thought nobody can audit is not a thought. It is a risk.

items.name: chancellery/address-09-corrected
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: Nobody Is Punished
items.text: Niemand wird bestraft. Einige werden korrigiert.
items.subtitle_pirate: Nobody is being punished. Some are being corrected.

items.name: chancellery/address-10-temporary
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: Temporary
items.text: Die Massnahmen sind voruebergehend. Sie werden jaehrlich verlaengert.
items.subtitle_pirate: The measures are temporary. They are renewed every year.

items.name: chancellery/address-11-games
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: A Civic Pressure Valve
items.text: Der Wettkampf ist ein Ventil. Er ist geregelt, er ist sicher, und er ist freiwillig fuer alle, die sich dafuer qualifiziert haben.
items.subtitle_official: Sanctioned competition: regulated, safe, and voluntary.
items.subtitle_pirate: The games are a pressure valve. Regulated, safe, and voluntary for everyone who qualified for them. Listen to that last part again.

items.name: chancellery/address-12-disappointed
items.speaker: chancellor
items.title: Disappointed
items.text: Wir sind nicht veraergert. Wir sind enttaeuscht. Das ist bedauerlicherweise schlimmer.
items.subtitle_pirate: We are not angry. We are disappointed. Regrettably that is worse.
